categories.main_business_segments: Keshun Waterproof Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the building waterproofing industry, focusing on waterproof materials, waterproof engineering construction, seismic isolation and damping products, civil building materials, building and home repair, photovoltaic energy, and overseas business. The core segments include industrial and civil building waterproofing, civil building materials, repair services, seismic isolation products, and international market expansion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced polymer chemistry technologies, including proprietary root-resistant agents for waterproof membranes, and utilizes extrusion, calendering, and coating processes for producing asphalt-based and polymer waterproof membranes. It integrates intelligent manufacturing with AI, robotics, and industrial internet platforms for flexible, order-based production, and emphasizes green, low-carbon materials and processes aligned with national sustainability goals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Keshun serves large state-owned enterprises, well-known real estate developers, general contractors, and commercial enterprises primarily in industrial buildings, civil buildings, public facilities, infrastructure projects, and urban renewal. Key markets include municipal infrastructure, rail transit, airports, nuclear and water conservancy projects, photovoltaic rooftops, and residential renovation, with strategic partnerships with major Chinese central enterprises and private companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production and R&D bases in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Liaoning, Shandong, Chongqing, Shaanxi, Hubei, and Fujian provinces. It also has established overseas presence in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, North America, and Europe, focusing on Belt and Road Initiative countries, with key international markets in Malaysia, Vietnam, and Indonesia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Keshun operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the building materials supply chain, manufacturing waterproof materials and providing waterproof engineering services. It also engages in upstream R&D and raw material procurement, including strategic reserves and hedging of petrochemical raw materials, positioning itself as an integrated solution provider in the waterproofing industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development through technological innovation, focusing on green, low-carbon waterproof materials, intelligent manufacturing, and digital transformation. It invests in R&D for advanced polymer membranes, environmentally friendly coatings, and integrated waterproofing solutions, collaborating with top universities and industry partners to develop next-generation products and smart construction technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Keshun generates revenue mainly through product sales of waterproof membranes, coatings, and seismic isolation products, as well as providing waterproof engineering construction services. It employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales to large enterprises and extensive dealer networks, supplemented by retail channels including live-stream e-commerce platforms to reach end consumers and small contractors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's building waterproofing industry, recognized as a top brand with significant market share among over 3,000 industry participants. It competes by leveraging strong R&D capabilities, brand reputation, comprehensive product portfolios, and strategic partnerships with major state-owned and private enterprises, benefiting from industry consolidation and rising quality standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Keshun reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.83 billion, a 14% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 44 million, a significant turnaround from prior losses. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 14 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and digital transformation, aiming for sustainable growth despite cyclical industry challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Keshun emphasizes durable, high-performance waterproof materials with proprietary technologies such as root-resistant agents and advanced polymer membranes offering superior aging and corrosion resistance. Its integrated solutions cover product innovation, technical services, and engineering, supported by intelligent manufacturing and digital platforms, delivering reliable, environmentally friendly, and customized waterproofing systems that extend building lifespans and ensure safety.
